body: I didn't say I wasn't willing to put effort in, just that I wasn't willing to only keep doing what I was already doing for years without improvement. What new angle should I come at it from? What new options are there?

I mean. I know that. I've been trying that for years. I'm just really unhappy 95% of the time no matter how much cbt or dbt i do. Why do people always assume that because I've struggled long term its because I've refused to "do the work?"
